title: With a trailing navelcord, hushed in
html_source:
This is a very disturbing image which is lost in subsequent obscure statements. The fact of his own birth, facilitated by a mid-wife, conjoins an image imagined by Stephen of a newborn or miscarried foetus, umbilical and all, dead or killed by the wool.

On reflection, the implication is an unease with birth its biological imperatives (Strandentwining Cable': Joyce, Flaubert, and Intertextuality
By Scarlett Baron).
